test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6b44edc6ff32ece90cbdcda1ab87d3ebcdc774610d4f7331a390da0961c95eb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The top element and last two elements of 2nd row from the left shift anticlockwise subsequently.

2) The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

3) Alternately the 3rd column elements are replaced by new elements starting from the second box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca580aa66e801adfe7ed2d97d85576d254bc7d01fe111ec63c08768addd769f8.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914a2f77c3973967b5fa07b7b70c08a83f440da409bb81d426c56954de6e92f1.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
